messages.author: e8298086d5ac3e1f
messages.subject: Predict function on concentration parameter
parts:
Dear group,
I have a query regarding usage of the predict function upon brmsfit models. I wish to get predictions on the concentration parameter (kappa) of a model with von_mises distributed outcome data. The model is of the form: 

Formula: radians ~ 1 + (1 | id) + (1 | pos),  kappa ~ exp(rp) + (1 | id) + (1 | pos)

Upon running predict on a brms object, I receive the following error:

Error in if (c * (2 - c) - U2 > 0) { : 
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

and no predicted values are produced. Although the model has converged there are divergent transitions associated with it. Is it possible to get predicted values for kappa from this model formula?

Kind regards,
John Kirwan

messages.author: 6e3dd74b422c061b
messages.subject: Re: Predict function on concentration parameter
parts:
Hi Kirwan,

I see two issues here.

First, there is apparetnly a bug in the predict method that causes the error you are reporting. I will work on fixing this within the next few days.

Second, do I understand you correctly, that you want to extract the predicted values of kappa, not of the response itself?
There is currently no function returning these values, but I will add an option for it soon.

Best,
Paul
